experiment_metadata.timing: Independent five-system execution, rotated order and one authored warmup each, CPU. Router features/decision included; model/index/statistics setup and metrics/I/O excluded. Source reranker traced through a lightweight observer.
experiment_metadata.no_tuning: No policy-selection or optimization API is used by Phase 4; exact saved Phase 3 policy imported before data loading.

dataset.name: beir-nfcorpus
dataset.attribution: NFCorpus: Boteva, Gholipour, Sokolov and Riezler, A Full-Text Learning to Rank Dataset for Medical Information Retrieval, ECIR 2016; BEIR: Thakur et al., 2021.
dataset.changes: Required BEIR data files copied byte-for-byte; raw archive preserved. No documents, IDs, text or grades filtered or rewritten. Added provenance metadata.
dataset.evaluation_split_selection: Official test preselected in frozen protocol; train/dev inspected for format/counts only, not tuning
dataset.unjudged_convention: Zero evaluation gain, not known irrelevant

generalization.comparison_scope: Cross-dataset score subtraction is descriptive and UNPAIRED; no cross-dataset paired confidence interval. SciFact full has four methods, internal slice has five. Their sample sizes and dates differ.
possible_explanations: Different query task and judgment density/grades can affect metrics and failure-indicator rates; not isolated causal effects.
Corpus size, text length, truncation and CPU/runtime conditions may influence latency and quality.
unsupported_claims: Adaptive benefit from a hybrid-only policy
generalization.limitations: One additional biomedical collection, no retuning, single warmed CPU pass. Query bootstrap is descriptive and uncorrected for multiple comparisons, not repeated-run timing uncertainty.

unjudged_convention: Zero evaluation gain, not known irrelevant
